thread.topic: Changing some rules on minigames and knife

posts.subject: Changing some rules on minigames and knife
posts.bodyHtml:
I would like to suggest to change the camp rules on those server to Don't camp at all.


In my opinion, it would be the best because even with the rules we have, it's annoying to see anyone camping.

Sorry Luckiris but was it really necessary to create whole thread because of this? I don't even know what did you want to say with that. Camping is allowed for 10 seconds and that is good enough. No camp rule would only give us more problem with constantly slaying/kicking/baning everybody. My opinion, no offense.

In my opinion, the 30 sec camp allowed on MG is waaaayy to much, 10 sec is good enough tbh.
So I want them to change the 30 sec on MG to MAX 10 sec


And also for knife, when a player walk by some sort of ladder and they hear someone climbing they have to stop and kill you and then say "no didn't camp ladder" which is kinda annoying


But keep the 10 sec on knife and fix it to MG in the rules
